up: For human JAK3 (target ChEMBL ID: CHEMBL2148), return all activity rows where the standard_type is 'IC50'. For each row, provide the following columns: the molecule's ChEMBL ID, its canonical SMILES, the compound_key, the pubmed_id or doi (preferring pubmed_id if both exist), the assay description, the target preferred name, and the target organism.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2148'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM';
